content: आकाङ्क्ष् €1 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To desire, long or wish for, expect; प्रत्याश्वसन्तं रिपुराचकाङ्क्ष <ls>R. 7. 47</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 38</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 162</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">10. 121</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 153</ls>; आकाङ्क्षन्ती नयनसलिलोत्पीडरुद्धावकाशाम् (तां पश्य) <ls>Me. 91</ls>. .²2 To try to reach a place, turn to; दक्षिणां दिशमाकाङ्क्षन् <ls>Ms. 3. 258</ls>. .²3 To require, need. .²4 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) To require some word or words to be supplied for the completion of the sense; see आकाङ्क्षा below.
